distribution.narrative: Beaver & Liu (2010) directly records Taiwan, including Ilan, Fu Shan. Lin & Smith (2022) independently records Taiwan. No mainland occurrence is inferred.

host_note: Beaver & Liu (2010) reports the host as unknown; Lin & Smith (2022) adds no host evidence. No confirmed host is promoted.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Cyclorhipidion xyloteroides (Eggers, 1939).

taxonomic_history.name: Cyclorhipidion xyloteroides
taxonomic_history.note: Current accepted name in the integrated taxonomic backbone.

nomenclature_note: Beaver & Liu (2010) treats Cyclorhipidion xyloteroides and records the 2010 new combination; canonical identity and authorship follow integrated taxonomic backbone: Cyclorhipidion xyloteroides (Eggers, 1939), VSN_2066.
